R02_01_MODEL_SELECTION.title: cur_tag priority and AMBIGUOUS_TARGET ordering
R02_01_MODEL_SELECTION.fix: In _invoke_g2_model, cur_tag (srv._current_model) is evaluated first. If a valid, unambiguous current model is bound, it is selected. AMBIGUOUS_TARGET is only raised when no explicit model_ref is given, no valid cur_tag is bound, and multiple models exist on the server.

R02_02_VALIDATE_REPORT_UNBOUND.title: validate.report execution with ref_mapping=None
R02_02_VALIDATE_REPORT_UNBOUND.fix: Allowed validate.report to execute without an explicit model binding. Updated comsol_mcp/_execution_service.py to whitelist validate_report and validate.report for unbound execution. Handled ref is None gracefully in comsol_mcp/_managed_backend.py _invoke_g3_model.

R02_03_PROJECT_ROOT_CONFIG.title: COMSOL_PROJECT_ROOT configuration in live engine acceptance runner
R02_03_PROJECT_ROOT_CONFIG.fix: In tools/run_g3_9_acceptance.py execute_live_engine_cases, set server_env['COMSOL_PROJECT_ROOT'] = str(self.repo_root) to ensure subprocess MCP server recognizes repo_root as authorized project root for ArtifactStore.

R02_04_REPORT_SAFE_PATH.title: validate_report destination safe path resolution and atomic dual publishing
R02_04_REPORT_SAFE_PATH.fix: In comsol_mcp/_g3_w20_validation.py, verified store project root alignment with COMSOL_PROJECT_ROOT and added canonical fallback resolution for symlinked prefix systems (macOS /var -> /private/var), ensuring destination inside repo_root safely resolves and atomically publishes JSON and MD reports.
